title: Dan Aykroyd, 74, Reveals Transcripts from His Great-Grandfather Séances, Says He Was 'the Original Ghostbuster'
excerpt: The actor is proud of his family’s historical connection to spiritualism
content:
Angela Andaloro

Thu, October 22, 2026 at 5:32 PM UTC

NEED TO KNOW

  • Dan Aykroyd shared a piece of his family history with fans online

  • The actor, 74, talked about learning about spiritual work through his great-grandfather, Dr. Sam Aykroyd

  • Aykroyd called his ancestor ‘the original Ghostbuster’ as he shared his journals

Dan Aykroyd comes from a long line of paranormal investigators.

The Ghostbusters star, 74, shared photos on Instagram on Wednesday, Oct. 21, showing pages of transcripts from his great-grandfather’s séance work.

“These are my great-grandfather Dr. Sam Aykroyd’s transcripts from the séances he hosted in the Old Farmhouse. It was the spirit of his work passed down through the generations that inspired my interests. He’s the original Ghostbuster,” he captioned the carousel of photos.

Aykroyd previously chatted about the “family business” in a 2020 interview with Yahoo Entertainment. The actor explained that his grandfather started out teaching and later became a dentist who used hypnosis to comfort patients. He then conducted and bore witness to séances, which he documented in the tomes passed down to Aykroyd.

“Most places in Canada you’d see Look magazine or National Geographic or Life magazine all stacked up. In my house, it was the American Society for Psychical Research magazines, Fate magazine, British Society for Psychical Research, all of these publications that studied the paranormal. So I just grew up with it. … There was no way out of it,” he told the outlet.

In an interview with CBC that same year, Aykroyd explained that he has turned to his belief in spiritualism when experiencing the deaths of loved ones. He used late friend John Belushi as an example.

“I had a medium work with his spirit to cross him over. And you know, that medium said: ‘What does the word Nunya mean to you?’ [I said,] ‘Nunya? I don’t know what that means,’” he recalled.

Aykroyd consulted Jim Belushi, John’s brother, who shared that “Nunya” was John’s name for their grandmother. The actor noted, “So John spoke through his medium to me, to make sure that I knew that he’d gone across.”
